name: coco-desktop
description: cocopilot in its own window: starts the coco server when none answers, a menu bar icon, a dock badge and a global shortcut

scripts.icons: swift scripts/icon.swift build/icon.png 512 && swift scripts/icon.swift build/trayTemplate.png 9 t && swift scripts/icon.swift build/trayTemplate@2x.png 18 t
scripts.install-app: npm run pack && rm -rf /Applications/coco.app && cp -R dist/mac-arm64/coco.app /Applications/
